We visited this trail on October 4th under perfect weather—clear skies and a crisp autumn breeze that made for an enjoyable outing. We were really looking forward to those iconic grand views of vibrant fall foliage in four stunning colors, especially from the hilltops. Unfortunately, the scenery didn’t quite deliver on that front: it’s mostly enveloped in dense, beautiful forest the whole way, with very limited vistas. There are just a couple of rewarding spots—a glimpse of a mountain across the field right at the trailhead and another at the end of the loop—but that’s about it. If you’re heading here hoping for sweeping panoramas of the sea or a colorful canopy from above, you might want to temper those expectations.
That said, the forest itself is a highlight, with lush greenery and hints of early color that make it feel serene and immersive. The trail is rated moderate and features a fair share of ups and downs, but it’s surprisingly approachable and family-friendly for most fitness levels—nothing too strenuous, and the loop design keeps things varied without feeling overwhelming. We’d recommend it for a peaceful woodland stroll rather than a scenic summit experience. Solid 4/5 stars for accessibility and tranquility!

This is such a beautiful, majestic trail!! It’s now my top favourite in Ontario...or at least southern Ontario. 

When we arrived the parking lot for the trail was packed. We were kinda bummed with the idea of being on the trail with hundreds of other people. But strangely, although you do pass a few hikers ...it doesn’t feel crowded. And the people on the trail are so kind, with the best trail etiquette. My guess because this hike is 100% moderate...with big fabulous heart pounding butt burning inclines...followed by fun runs down the declines...that those who are on this trail, it’s not their first rodeo.

There are two loops which equal 14km. We got super confused and missed one of the loops so only did about 6km. I think it’s because I got a text message telling me Biden had won the presidency...and with all our hollering and dancing we got off track. That was the best moment ever! 

For your après hike, I recommend swinging by Adamo Estate winery which is about a two minute drive away...and treat yo’self to a glass of dry rosé while sitting amongst the vineyards. Unfettered joy. Living our best life...always!
